svg.aria-label: The read and push path with real sizes: the latent through a fixed map into a tuned image encoder, scored against a right and a wrong sentence, with the gradient taken at the latent and subtracted from the base noise prediction.
svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: A noisy latent read against two sentences, with every size
S right minus S wrong (a number between −2 and 2)
a cat to the left of a dog
a dog to the left of a cat
linear map to RGB, no VAE decode: 3 × 128 × 128
resize to 3 × 224 × 224 and normalise (not in the released code)
